issues.detail: The Hebrew 'שֹׁסֵ֖י נַחֲלָתִ֑י' means 'plunderers of my heritage/inheritance' (those who plunder my inheritance), not 'the desolation of my inheritance' (產業的荒涼). The Chinese renders the noun 'plunderers' as 'desolation', changing the subject from people who plunder to a state of ruin.
